title: eupatorium rugosum var. villicaule
intro: Eupatorium rugosum var. villicaule, commonly known as White Snakeroot, is a perennial plant native to North America, characterized by its white, fragrant flowers and hairy stems. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of White Snakeroot include its ability to calm and relax the nervous system, reduce fever, and promote digestion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
